### ***optimised_ao*** A faster and more accurate Ambient Occlusion calculation on a single mesh. This is vertex-based compound and as such you will get both better looking yet slower results as the vertex count increases. Some settings are provided to assist in faking a good look on lower-resolution meshes.
*** ## Input ***input_mesh***
Single mesh input. The ambient occlusion will be calculated on this mesh, the vertex count is important. ***casting_sphere_radius***
As the AO is generated by raycasting from each point, this is the radius of the sphere that generates the ray positions for raycasting. ***AO_resolution***
This is simply the number of points in the raycasting sphere. As this increases, the process will get slower, but more information will be gathered, generating a better quality result. ***AO_brightness***
Once the rays are cast from the sphere, they are checked for "hits". If they hit nothing, a small amount of brightness is added to the vertex colour, this is how bright that it. ***Infinite***
If checked, this will shoot out the rays to "infinity". This is slower, but useful in some cases. ***max_raycast_distance***
When `Infinite` is **not** checked, this is the maximum distance the ray will travel before reporting it's result. The results of this are dependent on the size of your object. ***min_raycast_distance***
The distance that ensures the ray doesn't just detect the point it was emitted from. ***normalize_AO***
Scales the results of the compound to a 0-1 (black -> white) range. ***adjust_AO***
A curve that allows you to adjust the AO result. ***normalize_output***
When this is checked, the output data is scaled to a 0-1 range. ***AO_property***
This is the output property carried on the object. It defaults to `point_color` but is a `float` property, so you can set a custom property. ***blur_result***
If this is checked, the resulting ao will be blurred (averaged). ***blur_iterations***
if `blur_result` is checked, these are the number of iterations of the average blur. *** ## Output ***mesh_with_AO***
Description.
